title: Join this group
lede: Somebody sent you a code that lets you join their group. Enter the name they will know you by - that is all this asks for.

form.title: Who is joining
form.description: The group will use this name wherever it names you: on a commitment, in a settlement plan, and beside your share of it. Nothing here checks the name - who is joining is decided by the account you signed in with.
form.identity: You are joining as yourself. The group is told who joined by the account you signed in with, so nothing on this page can name somebody else.
form.name: Your name, as the group will know you

joined.title: You are in
joined.description: The group has you as a member now. This is the whole of what accepting the code did.
joined.name: {name} is a member of this group.
joined.idNote: That identifier is the account you joined with, which is the same one every other screen shows beside your name.
